metrics.name: PUE
metrics.query: SELECT sum(power_kwh) AS power_kwh, sum(it_kwh) AS it_kwh, 1.0 * sum(power_kwh) / sum(it_kwh) AS pue FROM events WHERE run_id = 'normal-69a3c5'

metrics.name: WUE
metrics.query: SELECT sum(water_gal) AS water_gal, sum(it_kwh) AS it_kwh, 3.785 * sum(water_gal) / sum(it_kwh) AS wue FROM events WHERE run_id = 'normal-69a3c5'

metrics.name: ERF
metrics.query: SELECT sum(heat_exported_kw) AS heat_exported_kw, sum(power_kwh) AS power_kwh, 1.0 * sum(heat_exported_kw) / sum(power_kwh) AS erf FROM events WHERE run_id = 'normal-69a3c5'
